label: Claude Fable 5.2
output:
To: #team-selection
Replying to: s01
Cc: none
Subject: none

Good evening Marek,

Thank you for posting the lineup. I do not agree with Liliana being placed as reserve, and I would ask you to look at it again before the names go to the organisers on Friday.

On 1 October you wrote here that selection would be based on two things, the November list and form in club events including the rapid qualifier, and that the coaches of the players would be consulted before the final lineup. I was not consulted about Liliana, and the lineup as posted follows the rating list only.

On form, the qualifier on 24 October is clear. Liliana finished second with 5.5/7. She beat Maja and Antoni and drew with Kacper. Igor was fourth with 4/7.

On rating, her 1851 is the result of losing 81 points in a single tournament, the Katowice open. She was not at full strength there for health reasons and still played every game, so that result does not show her real level. For the same reasons she missed about two weeks of training in October. She is back at her normal level now, and her last three lessons were very good. I would also point out that Igor is only 23 points ahead of her on the list, and that everyone from board 2 down to reserve is within those 23 points.

I want to be clear that this is nothing against Igor. I agree with Rafael that he has had a steady autumn, and he is a good boy who deserves his place in the team. My point is only that the criteria we were all given in October should be the ones applied.

My proposal is Liliana on board 2. If you would rather have it decided over the board, I am also fine with a short match between Liliana and Igor before Friday, and I will accept the result.

Please let me know which of the two you prefer, so that there is still time before the deadline.

Best regards,
Oksana
